name: Corva Yag
description: Corva Yag was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Rseik sector. By 214 BBY, the Hajara gang of pirates established a presence on Corva Yag, raiding Kett Shipping convoys traveling across the Little Minos Run hyperlane.
lead_paragraphs: Corva Yag was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Rseik sector. By 214 BBY, the Hajara gang of pirates established a presence on Corva Yag, raiding Kett Shipping convoys traveling across the Little Minos Run hyperlane.

Later, during the reign of the Galactic Empire, several hundred colonists on Corva Yag died. Their deaths were ostensibly caused by a malfunctioning 87-RM Scout Collector droid, although it was theorized by 0 ABY that the Empire had merely used the malfunctioning droid to cover up secret activities on the planet.
